notes.title: Notification of Added Supported Languages
notes.content:
We have added Russian as a supported language.
By changing the in-game language settings, you can now enjoy the game in the following languages:
Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Korean, French, German, Russian

notes.title: Major Update (Remake) Now Available!
notes.content:
The major update and remake of Matsuro Palette was released on November 15, 2024.

Uncover the fate of the girl in the painting who awaits you. The remake now supports 16:9 screen format and includes exclusive content, such as new episodes. Don’t miss out on the special launch discount available during the first two weeks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37852132/7c0ecbf0a5cf29e6de9b92aae3d3e116ffaba6ec.png[/img]

notes.title: 『まつろぱれっと』東京ゲームダンジョン6出展のお知らせ
notes.content:
We will be exhibiting at "Tokyo Game Dungeon 6" to be held on October 27, 2024, at the 5th-floor exhibition hall of the Tokyo Metropolitan Industrial Trade Center Hamatsucho.
We will be distributing clear coasters and postcards as a novelty.
If you are in the neighborhood, please stop by.

For more information about our exhibit, please visit https://gamedungeon.jp/events/tokyo6/exhibit_informations
